sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter. You can specify one or more filter names. Valid values:

- ServiceId: The service ID.

- Name: The service name.

- Status: The service status.

- SupplierName: The service provider name.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The list of filter values. The list can contain from 1 to 10 values.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: Ascending

- **Descending** (default): Descending
